intent: WP-LC1 follow-up: make the never-started escalation proof independent of hosted-runner uptime. The previous fixture subtracted 100 seconds from time.monotonic(); on a fresh VM with less than 100 seconds of uptime this made registered_at negative, so production's valid registered_at > 0 guard correctly suppressed the alert and ACTIVE_TRACK reported a false regression. Replace that ambient host-time assumption with a module-local deterministic clock while preserving the exact two-interval behavioral assertion and all production code.

negative_controls.name: clock-not-advanced-must-fail
negative_controls.command: python3 -c "import importlib,pathlib,tempfile; p=pathlib.Path('tests/test_loop_supervisor_tristate.py'); t=p.read_text(); anchor='        clock.now = 4.0'; assert anchor in t; p.write_text(t.replace(anchor,'        clock.now = 1.0',1)); m=importlib.import_module('tests.test_loop_supervisor_tristate'); setter=lambda target,*args: (setattr(importlib.import_module(target.rsplit('.',1)[0]),target.rsplit('.',1)[1],args[0]) if isinstance(target,str) else setattr(target,args[0],args[1])); MP=type('MP',(),{'setattr':staticmethod(setter)}); m.TestNeverStartedAlarm().test_alarm_after_two_intervals(pathlib.Path(tempfile.mkdtemp()),MP())"

commit.message: test(loop-closure): make never-started alarm clock deterministic

interface_mismatches: The committed ACTIVE_TRACK criterion loop_supervisor_tristate_honest regressed only on low-uptime hosted runners because its test fixture could manufacture a negative registered_at value; production behavior was unchanged.
honest_blockers: This is a test-determinism repair only. It makes no LOOP-1 CLOSED_LIVE, daemon-host, WP-LC3, WP-LC4, or Titanium closure claim.
The two deliberately red Loop-Closure consumption criteria remain INFO until their separately owned packets land; they are not weakened or removed here.
Exact-head hosted CI, independent review policy, and human merge authority remain required.
session_entry.rollback: Revert the deterministic clock fixture and this packet together. Do not restore a test whose result depends on hosted VM uptime.
